text.p: Applications for shares in the public offer to sell (OPV) in the privatisation of Portuguese bank Banco Totta e Acores were more than three times oversubscribed, an official source in the bank said.
"Demand in the public offer to sell (OPV) reached 5.78 million shares, that is 3.6 times the available supply (1.6 million shares)," the source told Reuters.
Wednesday is the last day for the submission of applications for shares.
The source had no information about the domestic and international direct sale of more than 6.3 million shares in Totta.

A special session will be held at Lisbon bourse on November 19 to announce the results of the sale of a 13.22 percent stake in Totta held by the government, amounting to 7,929,471 shares. The new Totta shares will be introduced to Lisbon bourse the following day.
